decisions.reason: The salary-and-wages sheet scope extension does not itself alter the allocated-budget requirement; message 2 independently establishes the JHS 157 budget, which is already represented.
The salary-and-wages sheet scope extension does not alter the service schedule; message 2 independently supplies the JHS 157 schedule fields, which are already represented.

The salary-and-wages sheet scope extension does not cause the signature requirement change; message 2 independently extends the signature requirement to JHS 157, and that scope update is already represented.
